title: Reading Personality Off the Steering Geometry of a Language Model: code and data
description: Research code and data for the preprint "Reading Personality Off the Steering Geometry of a Language Model" (Mado Kagerou, 2026). Recovers a personality trait structure from inside Llama-3.1-8B by factor-analyzing 27 contrastive activation steering directions across 409 personas, scored through a bias-cancelling pole-contrast readout. Includes the extraction and factor-analysis pipeline, the frozen 27-facet (D27) instrument, the extracted steering directions, the permutation-null and convergent-validity controls, and the per-experiment result files behind the paper's figures. No human data is included.
